title: Three Number Zero
constraints: Triplets are unique by values rather than index choices.

examples.explanation: All index choices produce the same value triplet [0,0,0].
No three distinct positions produce a sum of zero.

solutionApproaches.title: Enumerate All Triples
solutionApproaches.complexity: Time O(n³), Space O(1) excluding deduplication
solutionApproaches.explanation: Try every three-index combination, but it is too slow and makes duplicate removal difficult.

solutionApproaches.title: Sort and Two Pointers
solutionApproaches.complexity: Time O(n²), Space O(1) excluding sorted copy
solutionApproaches.explanation: Fix one value, then use a two-pointer scan for the complementary pair while skipping duplicates.
